name: The River of Rebirth
source:
River lost their husband, Ambrose, forty-eight years ago. However, a lifetime of research has led them to one fatal night: on the banks of the river where their beloved died, they have one shot at bringing him back to life... but is Ambrose the one who needs to come back to life?
